rationale: We eliminate the -$9,500 cash deficit by front-loading contiguous land expansion (20-24 plots) to complete by Day 9-10 with a strict Day 10 freeze, granting 2-3 additional recurring Strawberry flushes, while replacing the 2-cycle Carrot stalling with an immediate transition to hyper-fertilized Strawberries on Day 3 morning. We eliminate post-harvest regrowth stalls by requiring proactive watering can refills (< 30% capacity) before harvest passes to ensure 100% of harvested Strawberries are watered in-situ on the exact same tick. Furthermore, we halt margin degradation by raising the surplus batch liquidation trigger to >= 8 items at a >= 0.88x floor (>= 0.82x hard minimum), prioritizing Town Shop demand cross-checks, and banning late-game Carrot conversions.
